# OtdInterop public API. Generated by PublicApiSnapshotTests; do not hand-edit.
# Re-approve with OTDINTEROP_APPROVE_API=1 when a change is intended, and commit
# the result in the same change, so review sees the surface move.
#
# Two exported types are deliberate exceptions to "the library owns settings writing":
#   AtomicFile    - a general write-then-replace file mechanism.
#   SettingsCodec - a general serialize/deserialize mechanism.
# Neither reaches the session's active-settings writer, which is internal and mediated
# by IOtdSettingsSession. They are kept public because callers legitimately compose
# file and serialization operations of their own; the boundary was never a sandbox,
# and removing them would not stop in-process code opening a path itself.
#
# Recorded: accessor visibility, init vs set, static, readonly/const, enum numeric
# values, and actual optional-parameter defaults. NOT recorded, so a change to one
# of these will NOT fail this test: nullable reference annotations, generic
# constraints, attributes, and parameter names on delegates. This is a reviewable
# baseline, not a compatibility analyzer.

    .ctor(System.Int32 threshold = 20, System.Int64 windowMs = 2000)
    System.Boolean Allow(System.Int64 nowTick)
    System.Boolean IsTripped { get; }
